name: Leg extension
angleNote: Knee flexion: 90° = lower leg hanging (start), 0° = leg straight (end). Lifting makes the angle smaller. Hip at the origin.

segments.massNote: Segment mass as a fraction of body mass, and centre of mass as a fraction of the segment length from its proximal end. Approximate textbook anthropometry. The lower leg includes the foot.
segments.massSource: TODO: check against a published anthropometric table (e.g. Dempster's segment parameters as tabulated by Winter)
segments.note: Hip→knee and knee→ankle in metres, typical adult.

strengthCurve.label: Knee extensor strength
strengthCurve.note: Relative isometric knee-extension torque vs knee angle, assumed weakest near full extension and strongest around 60°. Approximate shape.
strengthCurve.source: TODO: verify against published torque–angle data

muscles.name: Vasti (quadriceps)
muscles.note: Vastus lateralis, medialis and intermedius: cross the knee only.

muscles.name: Rectus femoris (quadriceps)
muscles.note: Also crosses the hip; seated with the hip bent it is slack and contributes less. The weights here can't depend on hip angle.

phases.name: Lockout
phases.text: Leg nearly straight. An ankle weight is hardest here, exactly where the quads are weakest.

phases.name: Start
phases.text: Lower leg hanging. An ankle weight hangs almost under the knee, so there's little torque; a machine's cam can still load it.

variants.name: Leg extension machine

camProfile.note: Effective radius in metres: joint torque per unit of stack weight, including any lever or pulley ratio. Illustrative shape, not measured from a specific machine.
camProfile.source: TODO: replace with a measured profile for a real machine

variants.notes: Pad on the shin near the ankle. This illustrative cam eases off near lockout, where the quads are weakest. The lower leg's own weight adds torque too.

variants.name: Seated knee extension with ankle weight
variants.notes: Gravity: torque = (m·L + lower-leg weight)·g·cos(knee angle). Zero with the lower leg hanging, largest at lockout.
